result.reason: The operative indemnity substantially covers the preferred risks, protected parties, procedures, and IP remedies. However, it does not carve Vendor's indemnity obligations out of the general liability cap or subject them to the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. The margin comment's assertion that indemnities sit outside Section 21.3 has no operative effect. The unnumbered indemnity also does not clearly constitute the remedies referenced in Section 20.5. Otherwise, the changes are targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
